_meta.description: Ship definitions. One ship in the base game — the colony transport, upgraded by items in cargo (ship upgrades activate passively while held). Ship stats are set per trail in map_rules.json. The engine reads name_pool (the run's ship name) and base_stats.cargo_capacity_base (the cargo fallback when a trail sets no cargo_capacity).
_meta.design_note: There is one ship. The player does not choose it. They are already on it. The ship has a name — generated from name_pool at run start — which the ship computer refers to it by for the entire run. The name is always slightly wrong for what the ship actually is.
